capabilities: Resize the vertical tab bar by dragging its inner edge
Save the chosen width in data.json between sessions
Reset the width to 240px by double-click, Home key, or command
Support left and right placement and multiple tab groups sharing one width
Hide the handle while the tab bar is collapsed
extras: Relies on Just Vertical Tabs' DOM classes and --jvt-tab-width CSS variable, so upstream changes may require updates. Main desktop window only; pop-out windows are out of scope. Makes no network requests and does not read note contents.
intentEvidence: The tab bar is supplied by Just Vertical Tabs, and this companion adds its resize handle.
problem: Just Vertical Tabs offers no way to resize its vertical tab bar or keep a chosen width across sessions.

relations.evidence: This is an independently maintained companion to Just Vertical Tabs.

summary: Companion plugin that adds a drag handle to resize Just Vertical Tabs' tab bar from 100 to 600px and remember the width between sessions.
